Table of Contents Shrutika Patil September 11, 2026 1:52 pm DevOps has become an important skill for students and IT professionals who want to build a career in cloud, software development, and automation. With the right training, learners can understand how development and operations teams work together and how software can be delivered more smoothly. DevOps classes in Pimpri give learners a structured way to learn DevOps concepts, work with commonly used tools, and gain practical project experience. Selecting the appropriate course can help with learning for beginners. A good training program should cover the basics first, provide hands-on practice, and help learners understand how DevOps skills are used in real work environments. What Will You Learn in DevOps Course Certification Training in Pimpri? The training is planned to help learners understand DevOps from the basics and then move towards practical implementation. Instead of learning tools separately, you get to understand how these tools are used together in a real development and deployment process. Linux and Git: Linux is an important part of DevOps work, so the course covers commonly used Linux commands and basic system operations. You also learn Git and GitHub for managing source code, working with repositories, and handling changes in projects. DevOps Fundamentals: You start with the basic concepts of DevOps, including development and operations, automation, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and deployment practices. This gives you a clear idea of how DevOps works in an IT environment. CI/CD with Jenkins: The course includes Jenkins to help you understand how application builds, testing, and deployments can be automated. You get practical exposure to creating and working with CI/CD pipelines. Docker and Kubernetes: Container technology is an important part of modern DevOps. You learn how to create and manage Docker containers and understand how Kubernetes is used to manage container-based applications. Cloud and Infrastructure Automation: AWS and tools like Terraform and Ansible are also covered in the program. You learn how cloud infrastructure can be created, configured, and managed with automation instead of doing everything manually. Monitoring and Deployment: Additionally, you are exposed to monitoring technologies like Grafana and Prometheus. This helps you understand how teams track application and system performance after deployment. These topics are useful for learners searching for DevOps classes in PCMC, especially when the goal is to build practical skills rather than only complete a theory-based course. DevOps Tools and Technologies Covered in the Course DevOps professionals work with different tools for coding, testing, deployment, monitoring, and automation. Learning these tools during training can help students become more comfortable with common DevOps workflows. Depending on how the course is organized, students could work with: Linux and cloud platforms Git and GitHub Maven and Jenkins Docker and Kubernetes Ansible and Terraform Prometheus and Grafana Testing and deployment tools Instead of learning tools separately, practical training helps students understand where each tool fits into the overall DevOps process. This makes the DevOps tools easier to understand and use during projects. Who Can Join the DevOps Course in PCMC? The DevOps course is suitable for learners from different technical backgrounds. You don’t have to be a skilled DevOps expert to begin learning. Starting with the fundamentals, the training progressively advances to useful tools and tasks. For learners looking for DevOps classes near Pimple Saudagar, PCMC Pune this type of structured training can be useful for building DevOps skills step by step. Suitable for: New graduates hoping to work in DevOps IT professionals looking to add DevOps skills Developers interested in automation and deployment System administrators planning to move into DevOps Cloud professionals who want to improve their DevOps knowledge Professionals in the workforce considering a career transition Students who want practical exposure to DevOps tools Basic interest in technology and a willingness to practice are more important than having advanced prior knowledge.
